column1: # Draft G01 (subchapter 6.1): unit.state.cursor verifies only born (ignoring revision), whereas unit.state.result verifies both born and revision
# Norms: 6.1 Н1.9 «unit.state.result и unit.state.cursor», Н2 «Состояние в ответе» (P/06.1-18)
# Advance unit revision to 2: result (revision 1 != 2) stops acting, while cursor (born == $b) remains active
# Wrong born on cursor: cursor also stops acting, so state is omitted
